text:
sara: :wave: quick heads-up — final preflight in ~2h before the freeze. please do a final lint/ci rollup and make tiny PRs now. if you need a late-merge exception, call it out here with a short reason and a link to the PR. release checklist: changelog entry, bump version, run smoke tests, tag.
sara: also: if your PR touches runtimes or schema, ping @lee for rollout notes.
matt: doing a quick lint pass now. i have one tiny changelog micro-edit (docs only). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/9876 — should be safe to merge. :thumbsup:
lee: heads-up — the kv cache migration branch is still in flight on my end. i won't merge anything that depends on that until i finish smoke. ETA ~90m.
devon: i need a late-merge for a version bump of the model-profiles package — it only updates a json mapping used by CI (no runtime change). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pulls/1752 — can i get an exception? reason: avoids invalid ci on docs build.
sara: @devon paste the below in the exception form and i'll approve if CI artifacts are docs-only. make sure you include the release impact and rollback steps.
sara: exception form (fill & link):
```
PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pulls/1752
Category: docs/ci-bump
Risk: low
Why needed: prevents docs build failure in release pipeline
Rollback: revert PR and re-run ci
Owner: devon
```
release-bot: automerged check — repo models shows no runtime deps. auto-label: docs-only. :white_check_mark:
matt: thanks — i'll queue the docs micro-edit immediately.
sara: for anyone merging: please use the safe-merge snippet so CI doesn't retrigger unrelated flakes: 
```
git checkout -b tmp/changelog-bump
git cherry-pick <commit>
hub api repos/redwood/whatever/merge -f --body 'release preflight commit'
```
sara: and tag format for this cut is vX.Y.Z-rcN (no build metadata).
lee: once my kv migration completes i'll post a short note and hold off merges that touch kv tables.
devon: filled form and linked it: https://intranet.company/rel-exceptions/451 — hoping for quick green.
sara: acknowledged. if i approve i'll set the "late-merge-approved" label and note the rollback owner.
release-bot: reminder in 30m: code freeze starts in 90 minutes.
lee: :eyes: will do final smoke in ~40m and post results.
matt: merged docs-only micro-edit, CI green. PR 9876 -> merged.
sara: great — keep small, non-blocking merges only. if you cannot avoid a risky change, open a separate hotpatch runbook and tag me.
devon: approved label added by sara, tagging ops for visibility. :thumbsup:
sara: final call: anyone else? otherwise we'll cut the freeze in 90m and start the release tagging window.
matt: all clear from infra side.
lee: smoke PASSED — kv migration ok to continue post-freeze.
sara: thanks team — rolling into freeze. if you have a rollback script, drop it here for quick copy-paste.
sara: post-freeze note: exceptions granted only for critical-fixes and docs/ci. keep the rest for next window.
